title: What matters when building vision-language models?
grouping: A single left-to-right chain on the upper half: image icon (with an 'Up to 980x980' size label above it), vision encoder box, 'Hidden states' drawn as two small stacks of green squares, a modality projection + pooling box, and two more stacks marked '64'. The language model is turned into a tall vertical peach bar at the right edge; its input sequence is a single column of squares down its left side, green runs for image tokens (with ':64' ellipses) interleaved with dark orange text tokens, and the outputs are orange squares on its right. Text enters as a large serif 'T' glyph at the lower left whose long line runs along the bottom and branches up into the column.
shapes_depth: Flat, square-cornered boxes with thin dark outlines and pale fills (teal encoder, pale blue projection, peach LLM), no shadows. Feature maps and tokens are small squares with outlines; the hidden states are drawn as offset stacks of three squares with a dotted ellipsis, a flat stand-in for a 3-D tensor. Heavy black arrows with filled heads link the chain; the text branches end in hollow triangular arrowheads. Labels are serif.
proposed_highlight: No module is singled out; the eye goes to the two-colour token column beside the LLM, where green visual-token runs interleave with the orange text tokens and a '64' count marks how many tokens one image becomes.
lesson: Turn the LLM into a tall vertical bar at the right edge and stack its input sequence as one column of squares down its left side, so interleaved image-token runs (green, counted '64') and text tokens (orange) read as one ordered sequence.
notes: Title on arXiv is the study's; the caption and figure name the model Idefics2. No venue on the PDF or arXiv page; year = arXiv preprint year.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
